basic_details.job_title: OPSC AEE Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 758 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has advertised 758 posts of Assistant Executive Engineer in Group A of the Odisha Engineering Service: 750 AEE (Civil) for the Water Resources, Works, and Housing and Urban Development departments, and 8 AEE (Mechanical) under Water Resources. The posts carry Level-12 of the pay matrix under ORSP Rules, 2017. There is no OPSC examination and no fee: selection is on a valid GATE score (90% weightage) in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from GATE 2024, 2025 or 2026, plus an interview (10%).

important_dates.document verification (tentative): From the first week of December 2026; schedule on opsc.gov.in
important_dates.interview_date: After document verification; notified on the website

age_limit.details: Between 21 and 42 years on 1 January 2026 : born not earlier than 2 January 1984 and not later than 1 January 2005 . The date of birth in the HSC (10th) certificate is the only one accepted. | Upper-age relaxation: 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, women and ex-servicemen; 10 years for persons with 40% or more permanent disability; PwD candidates of SC, ST or SEBC get a cumulative 15 years. Junior Engineers of the Diploma Engineers' Service who acquired the degree later may apply up to 45 years, with not more than five chances. A candidate in more than one category gets only one relaxation, except the PwD addition above.

how_to_apply: Read the long advertisement and the instructions on opsc.gov.in before starting.
Register on the OPSC portal between 22 October and 11 November 2026 (5:00 PM). The form is system-driven; options open according to the data you enter, so enter it accurately.
For AEE (Civil), mark your order of preference among Water Resources, Works, and Housing and Urban Development; it is final.
Upload scanned images of a recent passport-size photograph, your full signature and your left-hand thumb impression; unclear images lead to rejection without correspondence.
Upload the documents listed below, including the QR-coded GATE score card for the year you choose and the Odia certificate if needed.

Submit. A Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN) is assigned. Take printouts of the registration and the final application, sign the declaration, and keep them with copies of the certificates to submit when asked.
There is no edit facility: to change anything after submission, cancel the application and apply again within the last date. Apply early rather than on the closing day.
HSC or equivalent certificate for date of birth
Engineering degree (or AMIE) certificate, Civil or Mechanical
Mark lists of all semesters or years, including any fail marks; candidates with grades attach the university's conversion certificate showing the equivalent percentage and formula
QR-coded GATE score card for the chosen year
Caste certificate for SC, ST or SEBC claims (see the certificate rules below)
Odia certificate, where the HSC certificate does not show Odia
Permanent Disability Certificate showing 40% or more, for PwD claims
Release certificate or certificate of expected release, for ex-servicemen
Sports identity card or certificate from the Department of Sports and Youth Services or Director of Sports, Odisha (participation or award certificates alone do not count)
No Objection Certificate, for Government servants
Identity proof: Aadhaar, EPIC, driving licence, passport or PAN
Third-gender identity certificate and name-change documents, where applicable
Every certificate must have been issued on or before the date you submit the online application; certificates issued later are not considered.
important_instructions: Reservation and relaxation for SC and ST (by birth) and SEBC apply to candidates of Odisha only. SEBC (non-creamy layer) certificates are valid for three years and must have been issued on or after 23 October 2023. An OBC certificate is not accepted in place of an SEBC certificate. Women claiming SC, ST or SEBC must submit a certificate showing "daughter of"; a certificate by marriage ("wife of") is rejected. Community once entered in the form is final; no change of category and no withdrawal of candidature is allowed. Certificates obtained just before applying and later found inadmissible lead to cancellation of candidature and punitive action.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Persons with disabilities (horizontal, within the above): 50 posts (13 women): Category I, visual impairment 15 (4 women); Category II, hearing impairment 16 (5); Category III, locomotor disability / cerebral palsy 10 (2); Category IV, multiple disabilities 9 (2). Sports persons: 8 posts (2 women). 612 of the 750 posts are backlog vacancies of previous years and 138 are current vacancies of 2025. Candidates must give their order of preference among the three departments in the online form; it cannot be changed before or after the result. Two Mechanical posts are reserved for persons with disabilities (one Category I, one Category II). Four of the eight are backlog vacancies. PwD and sports-person candidates are adjusted against their own categories; temporary disability does not count. Unfilled women's vacancies go to men of the same category, and there is no exchange between SC and ST. The number of posts may change without notice.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The qualification must be held on the date of application. The GATE rules decide eligibility as much as the degree does: Between 21 and 42 years on 1 January 2026 : born not earlier than 2 January 1984 and not later than 1 January 2005 . The date of birth in the HSC (10th) certificate is the only one accepted. Upper-age relaxation: 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, women and ex-servicemen; 10 years for persons with 40% or more permanent disability; PwD candidates of SC, ST or SEBC get a cumulative 15 years. Junior Engineers of the Diploma Engineers' Service who acquired the degree later may apply up to 45 years, with not more than five chances. A candidate in more than one category gets only one relaxation, except the PwD addition above. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have one of: passed the Middle School examination with Odia as a language subject; passed Matriculation or equivalent with Odia as the medium of examination in a non-language subject; passed Odia as a language subject in the Class VII final examination of a recognised school; or passed the Odia test of Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department or Board of Secondary Education, Odisha. Candidates without Odia in the HSC certificate upload a Headmaster's or Principal's certificate, or the Odia Test Pass Certificate, issued before the last date. The Commission may test Odia at the interview. Citizen of India; of sound health, to be confirmed by a Medical Board before appointment (the health provision does not apply to PwD candidates). Not more than one living spouse, unless exempted by the State Government. Government servants may apply if qualified and within the age limit; they must inform their head of office in writing and produce a No Objection Certificate at document verification . Candidates debarred by OPSC, another State PSC or UPSC for a period are not eligible during that period. All eligibility conditions must be met by the closing date, 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OPSC AEE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: HSC or equivalent certificate for date of birth Engineering degree (or AMIE) certificate, Civil or Mechanical Mark lists of all semesters or years, including any fail marks; candidates with grades attach the university's conversion certificate showing the equivalent percentage and formula QR-coded GATE score card for the chosen year Caste certificate for SC, ST or SEBC claims (see the certificate rules below) Odia certificate, where the HSC certificate does not show Odia Permanent Disability Certificate showing 40% or more, for PwD claims Release certificate or certificate of expected release, for ex-servicemen Sports identity card or certificate from the Department of Sports and Youth Services or Director of Sports, Odisha (participation or award certificates alone do not count) No Objection Certificate, for Government servants Identity proof: Aadhaar, EPIC, driving licence, passport or PAN Third-gender identity certificate and name-change documents, where applicable Every certificate must have been issued on or before the date you submit the online application; certificates issued later are not considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification in phases. Candidates are called in a reasonable number, category-wise, strictly in order of the uploaded GATE score, for scrutiny of the score card, documents, eligibility and reservation claims. Appearing at verification confers no right to selection. Shortlist for interview. After verification, about two times the advertised vacancies in each category (minimum five) are shortlisted on GATE score. Interview. Worth 10% of the total; the Commission may test Odia reading, writing and speaking here. Final merit. GATE score at 90% plus interview marks; the final list equals the number of advertised vacancies per category. Ties are broken first by interview marks, then by age (older first). After the result, OPSC publishes the GATE score (at 90%) of the last selected and last shortlisted candidate in each category, together with individual GATE and interview marks.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Service Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level-12, Cell-1 of the pay matrix under ORSP Rules, 2017, with dearness allowance and other allowances as sanctioned by the Government of Odisha. Probation: two years from the date of joining. Pension: appointees are covered by the contributory pension scheme (NPS) under the Odisha Civil Services (Pension) Amendment Rules, 2005; submitting the NPS application at joining is mandatory. Selected candidates are examined by a Medical Board before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Reservation and Certificate Rules
content_sections.text: Reservation and relaxation for SC and ST (by birth) and SEBC apply to candidates of Odisha only . SEBC (non-creamy layer) certificates are valid for three years and must have been issued on or after 23 October 2023 . An OBC certificate is not accepted in place of an SEBC certificate. Women claiming SC, ST or SEBC must submit a certificate showing "daughter of" ; a certificate by marriage ("wife of") is rejected. Community once entered in the form is final; no change of category and no withdrawal of candidature is allowed. Certificates obtained just before applying and later found inadmissible lead to cancellation of candidature and punitive action.

faq.question: Q1. What is OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: OPSC Recruitment 2026 is a combined recruitment conducted by the Odisha Public Service Commission for 758 Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil and Mechanical) posts in Group A of Odisha Engineering Service Cadre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 758 vacancies are notified, including 750 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) and 8 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for registration and submission of online application is 11 November 2026 up to 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for OPSC AEE posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering in Civil or Mechanical from any University or Institution recognised by the Government or Associate Member of Institutions of Engineers of India, along with a valid GATE score in the respective engineering discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years on 1st January 2026 (born between 2nd January 1984 and 1st January 2005).

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written examination?
faq.answer: No. OPSC conducts no examination for this recruitment. Selection is on the GATE score (90% weightage) and an interview (10%).

faq.question: Q7. Which GATE years are accepted?
faq.answer: GATE 2024, 2025 and 2026, in Civil Engineering for AEE (Civil) and Mechanical Engineering for AEE (Mechanical). Only one year's QR-coded score card can be uploaded, and the candidate is judged on that one.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement states that no fee applies because the recruitment is GATE-based.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Odisha apply?
faq.answer: Any Indian citizen who meets the qualification, GATE and Odia requirements can apply, but reservation and relaxation for SC, ST and SEBC are available only to candidates of Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. How many candidates will be called for the interview?
faq.answer: About twice the number of advertised vacancies in each category, with a minimum of five, chosen on GATE score after document verification.
